'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Israel]]
****At least 88 people are injured, including seven seriously, and nine buildings are damaged in an [[Iran]]ian [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missile]] attack in [[Arad, Israel|Arad]], [[Israel]]. A [[mass casualty incident]] is declared. [https://www.mako.co.il/news-military/2026_q1/Article-c5e2e4b64121d91027.htm (Channel 12)]
****At least 78 people are injured, including a 10-year-old, in [[Dimona]], Israel, by Iranian [[ballistic missile]] attacks. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-march-21-2026/ (''The Times of Israel'')] [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/iran-news/2026-03-20/live-updates-890625 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] issues an [[ultimatum]] to Iran to fully open the [[Strait of Hormuz]] within the next 48 hours or the [[U.S. military]] will "obliterate" their [[energy in Iran|energy infrastructure]], including [[List of power stations in Iran|all Iranian power stations]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/ce84073mr06t (BBC News)]
****A group of 22 countries in a joint statement calls on Iran to cease attacks and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. [https://theshillongtimes.com/2026/03/22/22-countries-urge-tehran-to-reopen-strait-of-hormuz/ (''The Shillong Times'')]
***[[List of attacks during the 2026 Iran war#Nuclear facilities|Attack on Natanz nuclear facility]]
****[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] and [[United States Air Force|U.S.]] jets strike the [[Natanz Nuclear Facility]], according to the [[Atomic Energy Organization of Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/21/iran-says-us-and-israel-attacked-natanz-nuclear-facility (Al Jazeera)]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****''[[Axios (website)|Axios]]'' reports that the U.S. has reportedly begun initial discussions on the next phase and what [[peace talks]] with Iran might look like. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/us-exploring-framework-for-potential-talks-with-iran-as-war-continues-report/3874319 (AA)]
***Iran fires two [[intermediate-range ballistic missile|intermediate-range]] [[Ballistic missile program of Iran|ballistic missiles]] at the [[Diego Garcia]] [[Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia|military base]] in the [[Indian Ocean]]. However, neither missile hits the base, with one of the missiles failing in-flight, and the other having been intercepted by a [[United States]] [[warship]] using a [[RIM-161 Standard Missile 3|SM-3 interceptor]]. [https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/iran-us-israel-war-updates-2026/card/iran-targeted-diego-garcia-base-with-ballistic-missiles-rb7MdZW1CfwRTauDYHOt (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
***The [[United States Central Command]] says that [[United States Armed Forces|its military]] has struck over 8,000 targets in Iran, including 130 [[Islamic Republic of Iran Navy|Iranian Navy vessels]], since the start of the war.  [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/centcom-chief-says-8000-targets-struck-in-iran-degrading-tehrans-military-capabilities/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***The [[Islamic Resistance in Iraq]] claims responsibility for targeting 27 [[List of United States military installations in Iraq|American military bases]] in [[Iraq]] and across the region over the past 24 hours. One police officer is killed in a drone strike on the headquarters of the [[Iraqi National Intelligence Service]] in [[Baghdad]]. [https://shafaq.com/en/Security/Iraq-s-Islamic-Resistance-claims-27-attacks-on-US-bases (Shafaq)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/21/drone-strike-near-iraqi-intelligence-headquarters-in-baghdad-kills-officer (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhia strikes]], [[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches attacks in [[Zaporizhzhia]], [[Ukraine]], against energy infrastructure, causing smoke contamination. [https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-hits-energy-facilities-in-ukraine-1774110223.html (RBC-Ukraine)]  
***Two people are killed and six others, including two children, are wounded in a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] drone attack in Zaporizhzhia. [https://apnews.com/article/peace-talks-ukraine-russia-zelenskyy-drones-861a4bc4ebccd55aa00715917d060036 (AP)]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***Two people are killed and another is injured in an [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian]] artillery strike in [[Belgorod Oblast]], Russia. [https://apnews.com/article/peace-talks-ukraine-russia-zelenskyy-drones-861a4bc4ebccd55aa00715917d060036 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Cuban crisis]]
**[[2024–2026 Cuba blackouts]]
***[[Cuba]] reports a nationwide [[power outage]] following a total [[electrical grid]] collapse, the third major blackout to occur on the island this month. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2026/03/cuba-reports-2nd-nationwide-power-grid-collapse-this-week/ (BNO News)] [https://apnews.com/video/cubas-power-grid-collapses-leaving-it-without-electricity-for-the-3rd-time-this-month-c83e92b291bc4e2faa479f7fc34ec8dc (AP)]
*Seven people are killed when a [[Qatar Emiri Air Force]] helicopter crashes after a techincal malfunction during a routine mission over [[Qatar]]'s territorial waters. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/six-killed-qatar-helicopter-crash-due-technical-malfunction-ministry-says-2026-03-22/ (Reuters)] [https://aviation-safety.net/wikibase/568240 (ASN)]
*Two [[Skiing|skiers]] are killed and 25 others are trapped, including five injured, in an [[avalanche]] near [[Ratschings]] in [[South Tyrol]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/a-deadly-south-tyrol-avalanche-kills-2-skiers-trapping-25-near-the-austria-border/ (CTV News)]
*Two people are killed in an [[explosion]] when a [[dump truck|tipper truck]] and a [[tank truck]] collide outside of a [[gas station]] on the [[Lekki-Epe Expressway]] in [[Ajah, Lagos|Ajah]], [[Lagos State]], [[Nigeria]]. Several surrounding buildings were destroyed in the initial blast and the ensuing fire. [https://punchng.com/truck-tanker-collision-triggers-fatal-gas-explosion-in-lagos/ (''The Punch'')]
*At least 230 people are rescued, ten of whom are hospitalized for [[hypothermia]], during flooding and storms in [[Hawaii]], United States. Around 5,500 people are evacuated ahead of a second storm. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20qj970gwro (BBC News)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/hawaii-flooding-evacuations-9.7137381 (CBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Protests against the 2026 Iran war]]
**Large scale protests occurs in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]] against the war. Demonstrators call for dialogue and diplomacy to resolve conflicts. [https://www.bastillepost.com/global/article/5710257-massive-protests-against-us-israel-strikes-on-iran-erupt-in-berlin (''Bastille Post'')]
**Anti-war protests and [[2026 Iranian diaspora protests|diaspora protests]] against the [[Government of Iran|Iranian regime]] are held at the [[Colonial Building]] in [[St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador|St. John's]], [[Newfoundland and Labrador]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/newfoundland-labrador/anti-war-protest-in-st-john-s-highlights-differing-views-on-iran-war-9.7137531 (CBC)]
*[[2026 South Australian state election]]
**In [[South Australia]], the [[South Australian Labor Party|Labor Party]] wins a [[landslide victory]] over the [[South Australian Liberal Party|Liberal Party]]. [[Pauline Hanson's One Nation|One Nation]] also secures second place in [[first-preference votes]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2026/mar/21/sa-state-election-2026-results-labor-confident-but-all-eyes-on-one-nation-vote-as-polls-close-in-south-australia (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Politics of the Czech Republic]]
**Around 200,000 people gather in [[Prague]], [[Czech Republic]], to express discontent with some steps taken by [[Third cabinet of Andrej Babiš|the current government coalition]], including cuts in defence expenditure and proposed changes to the financing of [[Public broadcasting|public service media]]. [https://english.radio.cz/calls-defend-public-media-letna-protest-draws-large-crowds-8881334 (radio.cz)] [https://www.srf.ch/news/international/anti-regierungsprotest-in-prag-in-tschechien-demonstrieren-zehntausende-gegen-die-regierung (SRF)]
